system.description:
Also at 6th level, your brilliance radiates in ways that cannot be ignored. Conversations bend around you, as if every word spoken must first pass through the weight of your presence.

When in a social encounter, your presence is an aura of magnificence that puts pressures on everyone involved that isn’t on your side. Roll 4 Martial Die, dividing each result in half (min 1) and recording each. You can choose a recorded result and penalize a creatures Charisma or Wisdom based check with it.

You do not add additional dice results to your recorded results when you exhaust your current results. You can only record the Martial Die results in this way once per encounter.
